name: conversation
purpose: The scrolling message log of a generative AI chat. It holds the thread (`ChatMessage` items, then whatever follows the last response: suggestions, an approval card), keeps the newest message in view while the reader is at the end, and stops following the moment they scroll up to read or copy an older message — a "Scroll to the latest message" button brings them back. It is a `role="log"` whose own live behavior is off, so streamed tokens are never read one by one; instead each `ChatMessage` that finishes (or fails) hands its text to the conversation's polite live region, once. It also sets where messages sit for the whole thread (`alignment`): `split` for a full chat page, `start` for a dense side panel or drawer (Cloudscape's rule for embedded surfaces).
useWhen: Any surface where a person and the generative AI assistant exchange messages: the assistant page, the assistant drawer, an in-flow helper.
A transcript that grows while the reader watches it (streaming responses, tool calls appearing).
avoidWhen: A one-shot generated block on a page (a summary card, an explanation beside a chart) → render `StreamingResponse` in place.
A log of system events with timestamps and filtering → use `log-view`.
A list of past conversations → a `table` or `item` list; this is one thread.
related: chat-message` — the item the log holds; announces itself through this component.
prompt-input` — the composer pinned under the log (outside it; only the log scrolls).
suggestion-group` — follow-up questions after the last response, or support prompts in the empty state.
empty-state` — what the panel shows before the first message (the block renders it instead of the log).
bestPractices: Pin the prompt input under the conversation; only the log scrolls.
Never auto-scroll while the reader is reading an older message: the component already stops following when they scroll up.
Use `alignment="start"` in drawers and side panels, `split` on a full page.
Keep one conversation per surface; a second thread is a second page or a history list.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the message log. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Conversation`).

props.name: alignment
props.doc: split` puts the user's messages at the inline end (a full chat page); `start` keeps every message at the inline start (a side panel or drawer).

slots.name: default
slots.notes: The thread: `ChatMessage` items in order, oldest first, plus anything that follows the last response (suggestions, an approval card).
